title: sequential Mirror experts
hypothesis: For ordered compositions of two expert transformations, one shared linear expert with per-role input/output Givens coordinates can preserve the function of four independent experts at lower actual payload bytes, including order-sensitive compositions.
mirror_coordinate: per-role input and output 2D Givens angles
logical_multiplicity: four role-specific linear maps composed in ordered pairs
prior_art_delta: Prior MoE work covers expert sharing/routing; the sequential composition screen tests ordered non-commutative function composition rather than single-step routing. The SRM001 research note recommends this as a decisive follow-up; sequential low-rank shared atoms are included as a strong simple control.
controls: one hard-tied expert reused at both steps
one shared matrix plus rank-2 per-role residuals
one shared matrix plus per-role scalar gates
one shared matrix plus per-role input/output Givens Mirror views

task.activation: none; linear expert functions compose in the supplied order
task.role_sequences: all 16 ordered pairs are sampled uniformly; (a,b) means expert a then expert b

teacher_modes.aligned: four functions generated by conjugating one frozen base matrix with per-role input and output Givens rotations in coordinates 0 and 1
teacher_modes.independent: four independently sampled full matrices, scaled for stable two-step composition

task.primary_metric: held-out output MSE over uniform ordered pairs
task.structure_audit: per-pair MSE, role-frequency balance, non-commutativity audit max ||F_b(F_a(x))-F_a(F_b(x))||

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across all methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At the development-selected learning rate, aligned Mirror must be <=1.25x independent MSE and <=0.65x independent payload; otherwise stop with fresh sealed.

training.role_sequence_source: uniform fixed random pairs, identical per method and world

storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state_dict and deterministic compact JSON config

success_gate: All three fresh aligned worlds: Mirror/independent held-out MSE <=1.10, payload <=0.65x independent, all 16 ordered-pair errors finite, and at least one order-swap audit is nonzero. For a Mirror-specific signal, also beat rank-2 residual at comparable actual bytes or quality; otherwise classify the useful-sharing result without Mirror-specific superiority.
failure_gate: Development gate misses; or in at least two fresh aligned worlds Mirror exceeds 1.10x independent MSE or payload exceeds 0.65x; or rank-2 residual matches Mirror quality at equal/lower bytes in at least two worlds (Mirror-specific failure).
boundaries: synthetic linear experts and supplied role sequences only
aligned teacher deliberately favors Givens coordinates
fixed-update learning efficiency only; no near-convergence capacity claim
two sequential steps and four roles only
